docs.title: Alice's Science Fair Project Report
docs.content:
My Volcano Project

For the science fair, I made a volcano that really erupts! Here is how I did it:

Materials:
- Baking soda
- Vinegar
- Dish soap
- Food coloring
- Clay to make the volcano shape

How it works:
When you mix baking soda and vinegar, it makes a chemical reaction called an acid-base reaction. This creates carbon dioxide gas which makes bubbles. The dish soap makes the bubbles last longer and look more like lava!

Conclusion:
I learned that chemistry can be really fun and messy. My little brother Bob loved watching the eruptions. My teacher Mrs. Martinez said I did a great job explaining the science.
